title: Guided Speed Boating Tour on the St-Lawrence
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The ride on the water is 20-25 minutes and you are required to arrive 15 minutes in advance to sign in.
You will get splashed but not completely wet. Typically, you do not need a change of clothes.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Get ready for a thrilling 20-minute adventure like no other. Experience an electrifying boating experience reminiscent of a James Bond movie—packed with high-speed, drifts and 360° spins that are bound to keep you refreshed.

Enjoy stunning views of Montreal’s iconic skyline and landmarks as you embrace the ultimate blend of adrenaline and excitement.

Perfect for thrill-seekers and families with kids alike. Book today for a ride you’ll never forget!

An adrenaline rush for all.
